# awx_settings_auth_tacacsplus (Resource)

This resource has no ID, so it cannot be imported. It manages a singleton that always exists in AWX. Declare it, and the first apply replaces the current values with yours.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tacacsplus_auth_protocol` (String) Choose the authentication protocol used by TACACS+ client.
- `tacacsplus_host` (String) Hostname of TACACS+ server.
- `tacacsplus_port` (Number) Port number of TACACS+ server.
- `tacacsplus_rem_addr` (Boolean) Enable the client address sending by TACACS+ client.
- `tacacsplus_secret` (String, Sensitive) Shared secret for authenticating to TACACS+ server.
- `tacacsplus_session_timeout` (Number) TACACS+ session timeout value in seconds, 0 disables timeout.
